title: Assistant Professor of Oral Health Policy and Epidemiology
bio: Dr. Tien Jiang is an assistant professor in the Department of Oral Health Policy and Epidemiology (OHPE) at the Harvard School of Dental Medicine (HSDM), where she provides expertise in education and prosthodontics. As a prosthodontist, she teaches in the HSDM predoctoral pre-clinic and clinic and practices in private practice. Jiang earned her Doctor of Dental Medicine (DDM) degree at HSDM. She then moved to the Midwest to specialize in prosthodontics at the University of Illinois at Chicago (UIC) and completed a Master of Education in Instructional Leadership at UIC College of Education. Jiang’s interests include interprofessional education and practice, health literacy, patient education, and curricular reform. She is the 2023 recipient of the Harvard School of Dental Medicine Fellowship in honor of Aina M. Auskaps, DMD, for her work in health communication and patient education.
